nodes.name: Survivor foundations
nodes.description: Pistol proficiency. Every path in the tree starts here; learning never grants equipment.

nodes.name: Reload drill
nodes.description: Reloads take 20% less time (×0.80). Reloads never drop below 0.65 s.

nodes.name: Steady hands
nodes.description: Add +4 damage to every personal firearm projectile: a worn pistol hits for 16 instead of 12.

nodes.name: SMG proficiency
nodes.description: Equip owned SMGs: rapid fire, short magazines and frequent reloads. Buy or loot the gun separately.

nodes.name: Shotgun proficiency
nodes.description: Equip owned shotguns: each shell fires a fan of pellets. Buy or loot the gun separately.

nodes.name: Rifle proficiency
nodes.description: Equip owned rifles for balanced damage and sustained fire. Buy or loot the gun separately.

nodes.name: Controlled penetration
nodes.description: Your personal shots pierce one additional enemy.

nodes.name: Rapid cycling
nodes.description: Time between shots ×0.85, about 18% more shots. Faster fire also empties the magazine sooner.

nodes.name: Marksman proficiency
nodes.description: Equip owned marksman rifles for deliberate, heavy single shots. Buy or loot the gun separately.

nodes.name: Machine gun proficiency
nodes.description: Equip owned machine guns: large magazines and sustained fire, offset by long reloads. Buy or loot the gun separately.

nodes.name: Stopping power
nodes.description: Deal 25% more personal firearm damage (×1.25), applied after flat damage bonuses.

nodes.name: Combat reload
nodes.description: Reload a further 25% faster (reload time ×0.75). Stacks with Reload drill.

nodes.name: Field fitness
nodes.description: Gain +35 max health in every defense.

nodes.name: Emergency aid
nodes.description: Unlock a personal heal: restore up to 35 health once per defense.

nodes.name: Brace the line
nodes.description: Unlock Brace: spend 30 stamina to halve incoming damage for 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Endurance drill
nodes.description: Gain +40 max stamina for more melee strikes and bracing.

nodes.name: Contact sweep
nodes.description: Your personal melee strikes also hit enemies in adjacent contact lanes.

nodes.name: Hardened survivor
nodes.description: Gain +2 armor: every contact hit deals 2 less damage.

nodes.name: Heavy strike
nodes.description: Add +22 damage to every personal melee strike, including sweep targets.

nodes.name: Veteran vitality
nodes.description: Gain a further +50 max health. Stacks with Field fitness.

nodes.name: Field engineering
nodes.description: Unlock fortification building; the Trap blueprint opens after your first victory. Structures gain 25% durability and damage (×1.25) in every defense, Mara's included.

nodes.name: Reinforced frames
nodes.description: Structures gain a further 20% durability and damage (×1.20).

nodes.name: Defensive fabrication
nodes.description: Structures gain a further 20% durability and damage (×1.20).

nodes.name: Outpost mastery
nodes.description: Structures gain a further 25% durability and damage (×1.25).

nodes.name: Grenade handling
nodes.description: Unlock the grenade action with 2 charges per defense: up to 105 damage in a 2.7-yard blast.

nodes.name: Incendiary handling
nodes.description: Unlock the Molotov action with 2 charges per defense: burning ground deals 12 damage every 0.5 s for 6 s.

nodes.name: Blast packing
nodes.description: Deal 30% more grenade and Molotov damage (×1.30).

nodes.name: Grenade bandolier
nodes.description: Carry 2 extra grenade charges in every defense.

nodes.name: Bottle carrier
nodes.description: Carry 2 extra Molotov charges in every defense.

nodes.name: Wide blast
nodes.description: Widen grenade blasts and burning ground by 25% (radius ×1.25).

nodes.name: Slow burn
nodes.description: Burning ground lasts 50% longer (×1.50).

nodes.name: Quick throw
nodes.description: Carry 1 extra grenade charge and 1 extra Molotov charge in every defense. Each ordnance cooldown is 15% shorter (×0.85).
